name: genes
description: One row per annotated CDS, sORF or pseudogene: identity, context, regulatory and sequence features, evidence, abundance, function and flags (GIPPA_SPEC.md §9.3).

fields.name: source_id
fields.description: Original ID of the input annotation (C14 id map; the locus tag when absent)

fields.name: end
fields.description: End, 1-based closed (bp; above the replicon length when the gene crosses the origin)

fields.name: partial
fields.description: Gene is partial (not eligible for detection statistics)

fields.name: crosses_origin
fields.description: Gene crosses the origin of a circular replicon

fields.name: tu_position
fields.description: Position in the TU (1 = first transcribed)

fields.name: tu_size
fields.description: Number of genes in the TU

fields.name: uniop_p_prev
fields.description: Operon-pair probability with the previous gene of the TU

fields.name: uniop_p_next
fields.description: Operon-pair probability with the next gene of the TU

fields.name: region_ids
fields.description: Semicolon-joined IDs of the regions overlapping the gene

fields.name: replichore_position
fields.description: Relative position on the replichore (0 = origin, 1 = terminus; M5)

fields.name: gc_local_dev
fields.description: Local GC deviation from the replicon mean (fraction)

fields.name: promoter_score
fields.description: Best promoter score upstream of the gene

fields.name: promoter_score_tu
fields.description: Best promoter score upstream of the TU

fields.name: tx_rate_max_tu
fields.description: Maximum predicted transcription rate of the TU promoters

fields.name: tx_rate_sum_tu
fields.description: Sum of predicted transcription rates of the TU promoters

fields.name: terminator_conf_downstream
fields.description: Confidence of the terminator downstream of the gene

fields.name: mrna_dg
fields.description: mRNA folding free energy around the start (kcal/mol)

fields.name: gc3
fields.description: GC content at third codon positions (fraction)

fields.name: detection_tier
fields.description: Detection tier used for the run

fields.name: gene_q_value
fields.description: Gene-level q-value (NA in tiers without one)

fields.name: detected_2pep
fields.description: At least two accepted distinct peptides

fields.name: n_peptides_multi_identical
fields.description: Accepted peptides shared with identical copies (count)

fields.name: n_peptides_shared
fields.description: Placed peptides shared with other genes (count)

fields.name: n_peptides_tolerant
fields.description: Accepted peptides placed by the tolerant route (count)

fields.name: coverage_frac
fields.description: Fraction of the gene covered by accepted peptides

fields.name: best_peptide_q
fields.description: Smallest q-value of the accepted peptides

fields.name: p_detect
fields.description: Cross-fitted detection probability from protein covariates

fields.name: abundance_imputed
fields.description: Abundance filled by the missing-value policy
